description: This PHP file defines a controller class `Profile` within the Opencart admin module, responsible for handling user profile viewing and updating functionalities. It contains methods for rendering the user profile page (`index`) and processing profile save requests (`save`).

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Controller class for managing user profile display and updates within the Opencart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the user profile page, populating template data with user information, and setting up page components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX requests to update user profile information, including validation and permission checks, returning JSON responses.
